exposure: Low-cost technique for respiratory support and thermal care during DCC
outcome: Rates of DCC in preterm infants
Feasibility and efficacy of a low-cost technique for DCC
cohort: Infants born at <32 weeks gestation in 2015 (n=46) and 2017-2018 (n=63)
finding: Implementation of a simple, low-cost technique for DCC at all preterm deliveries significantly increased DCC rates from 12.5% to 89.4%.
